name: Dennis Iveson
role: A scrap dealer on the old warehouse row; owes 80 pounds and has it; bought out of the burned warehouse

temperament.from: town-traits-draft-2026-09-29 (nerve, loyalty; willingness from 'a wounding they saw': yes 0.6, no 0.4, never 0.1)

card.who: A scrap dealer with a yard at the west end of the quay. He owes Mickey's book eighty pounds and laughs about it.
card.speak: Blunt, bluff, enjoys an argument. Laughs before he answers.
card.life: Forty years in scrap. Buys what the docks throw away, which lately is the docks. Has a yard lad for the heavy work.
card.fire: He bought ironwork out of the ruin of No. 4, cheap, from Agar's clerk, the same week.
card.rivals: Sells to anyone. Thinks Cammack is a boy playing at it.
